name: skill-diagnostics
description: Writes and audits Claude skills by the official best practices: an authoring guide, a full audit by scripts, four independent reviewers, a cold executor and a verifier with file-and-line evidence and one verdict, and a gate that has Claude audit every skill it changes before it finishes.

on_skill_write.title: When a skill is written
on_skill_write.description: What happens after Claude creates or changes a skill: gate (Claude audits it before it finishes its turn), suggest (Claude offers an audit) or off.
